mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.12%) compress discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as markets price in sustained accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.12%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 10.0% signals severe economic distress, triggering immediate market anticipation of aggressive policy support that produces positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 580) and retail sales (RSAFS > 340000) indicates accelerating consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds, or joint signal Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) rising above 98.5 signals manufacturing recovery, indicating improving economic momentum that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits strengthen.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 98.5, or regime-specific return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS < 130000) signals labor market deterioration, prompting immediate market anticipation of fiscal stimulus that generates positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS falls below 130000, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.12%) and high unemployment (UNRATE >= 10.2%) indicate severe recession with policy response, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as markets price in effective stimulus.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both conditions hold, or interaction signal Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market recovery (HOUST > 580) signals improving consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 580, or regime-specific return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 98.5) indicates expanding manufacturing output, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as market prices in stronger corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 98.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
